S1214.reason: VCLT Article 7 presumes heads of state, heads of government and foreign ministers may perform all acts of conclusion without full powers, and heads of mission have a limited presumption; B and D’s “only” limits are false.

S0587.reason: Universal jurisdiction lets every state prosecute a defined set of grave crimes regardless of territory or nationality, not every international crime, and it allocates jurisdiction rather than merely labeling offences universal.

S1059.reason: Party appointment of the tribunal is the general rule in inter-State arbitration; universal third-party appointment and a mandatory closed list are fallbacks or special regimes, and A and B state the same rule.
